newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria cuts crude oil prices in April - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria cuts crude oil prices in April - trade.

text.p: Nigeria has cut the price of Bonny light and Qua Iboe crude oil by 54 cents to just four cents above dated Brent in April, trade sources said on Monday.
In March the price was set at 58 cents above dated Brent.
The price of Forcados was slashed by 87 cents to 40 cents below Brent from 47 cents above in March, they said.
In addition to those and other changes NNPC has given customers an option to price their crude oil before or after the loading dates.
An option costing two cents a barrel has been offered to buyers who want to price their crude either five days before or 14 days after the bill of lading date.
For March loadings the option to price 14 days after loading was five cents a barrel.
